mutations.description: Replace the type-(iii) bottom half-width S-U by S+U.
Reverse the signed q*U Green term in the strip core.
Force alpha=acos(abs(2h-1)/lambda), losing the major branch below h=1/2.
Replace the oriented exterior half-angle alpha by pi-alpha.
Move lambda inside the circular-segment parentheses.
Use the exterior complementary arc pi-alpha.
Omit one of the two weighted exterior caps.
Reverse the sign of d_lambda in P-2hA=-4d_lambda.
